name: Silk Road Fund Co., Ltd. (丝路基金有限公司)
via: Russia's Federal Antimonopoly Service called the SIBUR-buying entity 'the Silk Road Fund subsidiary, controlled by the People's Republic of China' (TASS, 2017-01-11)
note: Chinese state investment fund financing Belt and Road projects; the fund's own site ('Footprints', silkroadfund.com.cn/enweb/, opened 2026-10-03) records that on 8 November 2014 President Xi Jinping announced China would contribute US$40 billion to establish the Fund. Holds 8.5% of SIBUR Holding (Interfax, 2024-11-05).
